title: Patch v0.3.15: Meditative+, the release: the set ships
notes: The Meditative+ set ships (R1420, R1178000): its 26 cards and 4 tokens join every pool that names no set, the deck builder, the Almanac and random decks, the AI's included (R1390's gate is empty; issue #1186's sweep of record holds the AI's shadow ban to half the set, R1186000). The set's own mechanics are the rulings of issue #1173's parts. Core #82 KY's Trial, which works across every set that ships (R831004), Discovers among five sets now; no other card of an earlier set changes. Beside the set, the win-rate table Meditative #50 CN Tech and Meditative+ #2 NA Tech read is filled for the first time, from a development run of this patch's cards (issue #1266, R1266000); no card's data changes for it.

player.title: Meditative+
new: The Meditative+ set: 26 cards and 4 tokens join the deck builder, the Almanac, random decks and every card pool that names no set.
changes: KY's Trial can offer the Meditative+ set.
CN Tech and NA Tech pick their cards from win rates the AI measured on this patch's cards, no longer at random.
